findings.description: AWS access key and secret access key are hardcoded in plaintext in the EC2 user_data script, which is visible to anyone with API/console access to the instance metadata or Terraform state, exposing long-lived AWS credentials.
The EBS volume does not have encryption enabled (encrypted attribute is commented out), leaving data at rest unprotected.
The EBS snapshot inherits from an unencrypted volume and has no encryption configured, exposing volume data at rest in the snapshot.
The security group allows inbound SSH (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing the instance to brute-force and unauthorized access attempts from anywhere on the internet.
The security group allows inbound HTTP (port 80) from 0.0.0.0/0 with no additional restriction, increasing the attack surface for the web application.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, causing instances launched in this subnet to automatically receive public IPs, increasing exposure to direct internet access.
map_public_ip_on_launch is set to true, causing instances launched in this subnet to automatically receive public IPs, increasing exposure to direct internet access.

findings.issue_category: missing encryption and public access controls
findings.description: The S3 bucket storing VPC flow logs has no server-side encryption configuration and no public access block/ACL restrictions defined, risking exposure or unauthorized access to sensitive network log data.
